0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, 11th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back) host the Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, 5th in the West and 2nd in the Southwest) in the Jazz's fourth game of the season, with Utah coming off a loss and sitting 1-1 at home. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Memphis has Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 123-103 loss in Memphis on October 21, and the two teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
